notes.title: Early Access Beta (v0.4.1)
notes.content:
Vehicle No. 4 — Release Notes  
Version 0.4.1a – Early Access Beta  

General Updates  
  
Simplified Unlocks: Unlock all content by completing every character on Difficulty III and once on Difficulty V.  
Vehicle Collision Damage: Colliding with enemies deals damage equal to your current armor.  
Enemy Collision Behavior: Enemies cause collision damage only once per second.  
Weapon Overview: Added stack and connection counters for active module behaviors.  
  

New Characters  
  
Thorn: A defensive-focused character.  
Emberly: Deals more damage with burn on enemies with oil.  
  

New Modules & Weapons  
  
Unstable Experiment (Module): Deals self-damage on every 3rd hit, but gives a large power boost.  
Hose Connection (Module): If Weapon A kills, reset Weapon B's cooldown.  
Push Back Ram (Module): Knocks enemies back, deals armor-scaled damage, and increases armor.  
Connected Module Highlighting: Connected modules show their counterpart.  
  

Visual Improvements  
  
New Character Portraits: Updated artwork for all characters.  
Enhanced Visual Effects: Post-processing effects added across all scenes and UI.  
Crit Damage Display: Critical hit damage now shown in red.  
New Background: Added environmental elements to improve background scene.  
  

Balance Changes  
  
Plasma Cannon: Buffed attack speed (1.5 → 1.8 attacks/sec).  
Flamethrower: Nerfed attack speed (2.0 → 1.7) and damage (/2 → /4).  
Dynamite: Damage halved (still cascades with half weapon damage).  
Armor Converter: Reduced critical hit chance and damage.  
Hydraulic Pump: Nerfed, now includes Mechanical category.  
Relay: Adds Electric Category.  
Base Health: Increased from 50 → 100.  
  

Misc & Bug Fixes  
  
Controller Fixes: Improved multiple controller input issues.  
Tutorials: Added more in-game instructional content.  
Linux Graphics: Switched to prefer Vulkan API for better performance.  
Vehicle Hit Sound: New sound effect plays when vehicle takes damage.  
Behavior Counters: New counter system tracks special character behaviors.

notes.title: Final Demo (v0.3.0) Release
notes.content:
This update focuses on finishing all the core features of the game. Now the game has a cohesive art style. The UI was completely reworked so that the player has more information what the game state is. Furthermore the socketing and removing of modules has been improved.

Weapon Categories

Each weapon has one or more categories. The more weapons you have of one category the more benefits your vehicle will receive. For now there are five categories but more will follow. Modules can add a category to a weapon by inserting it. Some modules (in the future) may provide benefits depending which category the slotted weapon has.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45319566/4498adf8e8c5c417ac779f158171cc68bbfd1fd3.png

Weapon Modification View

Now a detailed weapon modification view can be opened via right click on a weapon. Modules can easily swapped in and out now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45319566/09e865fe2ec7184b215ca1e44fa46d9a2ed0cbee.png

Detailed Weapon Overview

Details about all weapons can be viewed now by pressing TAB key anytime. Helpful to see if your machine works as expected ;-)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45319566/260cd164e4be5c95af8bfc2c4aede611291e9d8e.jpg

Others

 All sprites are updated to match a color palette and art style
 Weapons can now be upgraded via dragging them on top of each other if the have the same level. Weapons can also be swapped.
 Localisation is now available in English and German.


Future

The plans for the next update are MORE of everything:

 More weapons (rocket launcher, minion spawners, armor generator, hydraulic pump etc...)
 More modules of every kind
 More characters (e.g. character that deals more damage the faster your vehicle moves, etc..)
 More enemy types (rolling sprockets, fast moving enemies, enemies with laser attack)
 More bosses (advanced attack patterns, line AOEs, crossing AOEs)
